skill_name: Summarize the biography of a given historical figure.
workflow: Charles Darwin was a British naturalist who developed a theory of evolution through natural selection. He published his landmark work On the Origin of Species in 1859, which outlined the scientific basis for his theory and transformed the understanding of the natural world. Darwin traveled the world extensively, visiting South America, Australia and the Galapagos Islands among other places.
